svg.title: Ben Lomond to Farmington — real teal elevation contours
svg.desc: Real elevation-derived contour map of the northern Wasatch Front, Utah, originally north up; rotated 90 degrees counterclockwise, so north points left. Extent approximately 112.12 W to 111.70 W and 40.95 N to 41.40 N. Contour interval 20 metres. Source: Mapzen / Tilezen Terrain Tiles, AWS Open Data, Terrarium DEM at zoom 12 (approximately 29 m ground sampling at this latitude), cached project data. US elevation data courtesy of the U.S. Geological Survey. DEM smoothed with a 0.65-pixel Gaussian kernel for display; vector paths simplified with a maximum 0.35 SVG-unit deviation (approximately 6 metres on the ground). Summit markers use published approximate WGS84 coordinates. Vector paths only; no embedded raster imagery. Cartographic background, not a survey product. Sources: https://registry.opendata.aws/terrain-tiles/ ; https://github.com/tilezen/joerd/blob/master/docs/attribution.md
